description: A shell script for testing Git pack-objects multi-pack reuse functionality, including various scenarios of pack reuse, delta handling, and multi-pack index management.

methods.name: test_pack_reused
methods.description: Calls test_trace2_data to verify pack reuse for a given scenario.

methods.name: test_packs_reused
methods.description: Calls test_trace2_data to verify multiple pack reuse scenarios.

methods.name: pack_position
methods.description: Finds the position of an object within a pack index.

methods.name: test_pack_objects_reused_all
methods.description: Tests reuse of all objects across all packs and updates the index.

methods.name: test_pack_objects_reused
methods.description: Tests reuse of specific objects from packs and updates the index.
